# log by ListeningKit

> log runs your social media marketing from the terminal or from your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex). It reads and answers your DMs, groups and channels on X, Instagram, Slack, Discord and Reddit, in your own voice and from your own accounts. It is open source and installs as the npm package `@listeningkit/log`, which gives you the `log` command and the `logMcp` server.

## Get started

- [Install](https://log.listeningkit.com/docs/getStarted/install): install log and sign in your accounts
- [Connect your agent](https://log.listeningkit.com/docs/getStarted/mcp): add `logMcp` to Claude Code or Codex
- [Using log](https://log.listeningkit.com/docs/getStarted/usingLog): how you ask for work and what log does with it
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/matthewdonsemail-lab/log)

## Platforms

- [X](https://log.listeningkit.com/twitter): reads both inboxes as one, finds who is waiting on you and who engaged with your posts, and answers each in your own voice before the lead goes cold
- [Instagram](https://log.listeningkit.com/instagram): answers every DM about your offer as it lands, with text, a meme or a voice note, with no browser
- [Slack](https://log.listeningkit.com/slack): reads your client DMs in every workspace, finds who wants more work, and replies one line at a time in your voice
- [Discord](https://log.listeningkit.com/discord): watches the servers you are in live, answers whoever asks for what you do first, books the call in their DMs, and keeps your own paid community answered
- [Reddit](https://log.listeningkit.com/reddit): does the research (reads the subreddits your buyers post in, finds the leads) and drafts a reply that gives value first; you press send from your real account
